item.description: The Republican-controlled South Dakota Senate overwhelmingly passed a broadband ISP privacy measure Friday, resurrecting the bill after it had appeared dead a week ago. State senators voted 28-6 to pass SB-110 by Sen. Michael Rohl (R). In a narrower vote...
